scripts.db:sync: prisma contract emit && prisma db update
scripts.migration:plan: prisma contract emit && prisma migration plan
scripts.docker:dev:sh: npm run -s docker:dev -- exec app sh
scripts.docker:dev:psql: npm run -s docker:dev -- exec db sh -c 'psql -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d "$POSTGRES_DB"'
scripts.docker:staging:sh: npm run -s docker:staging -- exec app sh
scripts.docker:staging:psql: npm run -s docker:staging -- exec db sh -c 'psql -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d "$POSTGRES_DB"'
scripts.docker:prod:sh: npm run -s docker:prod -- exec app sh
scripts.docker:prod:psql: npm run -s docker:prod -- exec db sh -c 'psql -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d "$POSTGRES_DB"'
scripts.test:db:psql: docker compose --env-file .env.test -f compose.test.yaml exec db sh -c 'psql -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d "$POSTGRES_DB"'
scripts.test:db:up: docker compose --env-file .env.test -f compose.test.yaml up -d --wait && set -a && . ./.env.test && set +a && DATABASE_URL=postgresql://$POSTGRES_USER:$POSTGRES_PASSWORD@localhost:5434/$POSTGRES_DB prisma db migrate > /dev/null
scripts.test:db: npm run -s test:db:up && set -a && . ./.env.test && set +a && TEST_DATABASE_URL=postgresql://$POSTGRES_USER:$POSTGRES_PASSWORD@localhost:5434/$POSTGRES_DB vitest run; code=$?; npm run -s test:db:down; exit $code
